name: IT team · untrack .codx/workspaces/*/.env — a tracked .env survives the ignore rule
description:
Follow-up from the CISO whole-repo scan (`fbb93de8`, Done 2026-11-20).

## Finding (deterministic)
`git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform ls-files -- '**/.env'` returns exactly one path:

    .codx/workspaces/9e3d7f6b-caf7-4c3f-8034-e1350edbb118/.env

- Added in commit `21a461a` (`git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-status -- '.env' '**/.env'`).
- Content today: `grep -Ec '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=.+'` → **0** non-empty assignments, so **nothing to rotate**.
- Rule: `configuration.secret-file` (security_audit → require_approval, medium).

## Why it matters even while empty
The repo-root `.gitignore` already has `.env` and `**/.env`, but **an ignore rule never applies to an already-tracked file**. The day the workspace feature writes a real key into that path it is committed silently — exactly the incident class this repo has had before.

## Do (needs a human / an operator, the platform has no delete tool)
    git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform rm --cached .codx/workspaces/9e3d7f6b-caf7-4c3f-8034-e1350edbb118/.env
    git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform commit -m "Stop tracking .codx workspace .env"
Also verify the workspace bootstrap still creates the file locally when it is missing (it is written at runtime, it must not be read from git).

Execution channel: `docker_exec` into `codx-junior-api`, which mounts the repository root at `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `git ls-files -- '**/.env'` → **empty output**.
- A fresh workspace created after the change still gets its own `.env` on disk (untracked).
- Optional, separate decision: `codx-junior-workspace-default/.workspace.env` ships a literal `VNC_PW` (no variable expansion) — empty it or document that the default is public.

## Out of scope / not a finding
No `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `acme.json` or `letsencrypt/` is tracked or in history. The three `secret.high-entropy-token` hits under `codx-junior/workspaces/*/config/.config/` are the known UUID false positive filed as `22718217`.

Related: `25822947` (onhold — the remediation carrier), `248d0a54` (repo-root access, proven via the api container), `e70e0272` (scope decision).
